text:
Maya (PM): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. We got several asks for a clearer launch checklist for Hosted API streaming, Console cost visuals, and Optimize recommendations. Can we spell out the external milestones and internal gating criteria?
Lee (VP Product): External milestones: 1) Hosted streaming GA (public) targeted for 2026-07 end, 2) Console cost visuals public beta 2026-08 mid, 3) Optimize recommendations general beta 2026-09. Internal gating: perf stability, RBAC/compliance signoff, and metrics retention respectively.
Diego (Eng): On perf stability: we need two things closed: a) kernel selection integration tests (blocking, owner: Sanjay), b) streaming memory regression on long contexts (owner: Tara). Both have PRs but need more coverage.
Ibrahim (SRE): For the metrics retention/gating, the metrics pipeline needs to handle 7x peak ingestion. We're rolling autoscale changes this week; ETA for validation is 5 business days post-deploy.
Maya (PM): Nora (Sales) asked about customer notices and lead time for private deployments. Nora?
Nora (Sales): Customers expect 30-45 days notice for private infra changes. Also request clarity on feature flags: can we promise no forced client-side changes for GA?
Lee (VP Product): We will avoid breaking client APIs. Any client contract changes go through a deprecation ladder: alpha docs -> 60-day beta -> GA. Feature flags in Console will be server-side where possible.
Samira (DevEx): Docs plan: publish "what's changing" doc with migration snippets when we open the public beta. I'll prepare an SDK migration checklist and coordinate with SDK owners to freeze breaking changes during the beta window.
legal-bot: Reminder: For Optimize recommendations, if we surface per-customer cost comparisons, legal needs a privacy review. Please complete vendor/dataflow questionnaire.
Maya (PM): Good catch. Who will own the privacy questionnaire?
Samira (DevEx): I'll pick up the vendor questionnaire with Legal and Rina (Optimize PM). Samira -> legal sync scheduled tomorrow 11am.
Diego (Eng): One more technical dependency: Console's cost visualization needs aggregated per-route token accounting. That requires a small change in the billing event schema. I'm filing the change now; will mark as breaking for internal consumers only.
Lee (VP Product): Make sure the billing schema change is backward-compatible for external customers. Internal consumers can adapt during the beta.
Ibrahim (SRE): Canary schedule proposal: Hosted streaming canary 2026-06-28 for 48 hours, 2% traffic opt-in. We'll collect p95/p99 latencies and memory metrics.
Nora (Sales): For enterprise customers on private deployments who want early access, we'll offer a managed early-release program with a signed support addendum. Need legal review.
legal-bot: Noted. Please route addendum drafts to Legal with customer list.
Maya (PM): Action items: Diego to file billing schema PR + owners for kernel tests; Ibrahim to post canary run checklist and monitoring dashboards; Samira to draft docs and run legal questionnaire; Lee to confirm public beta dates and marketing messaging. I'll collate these into a customer-facing timeline by Friday COB.
Lee (VP Product): Also: keep messaging conservative. If perf regresses in canary we delay GA.
Nora (Sales): Please tag me in the private early access list. Need to coordinate account teams.
Maya (PM): Thanks all. I'll add the action-tracker to #product-followup and ping folks. :rocket
